source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** lets a visible **CHARACTER** be singled out. When these attacks reach Allocation Order, if at least one of the attacking models can see a **CHARACTER** model in the target unit, the active player may make that CHARACTER's allocation group the current one until the attacks end or the group is destroyed. If the group is destroyed first, the remaining attacks carry on in the usual order from the first group that still has models.

interpretation.question: Where does allocation continue after the chosen CHARACTER group is destroyed?

detail.appliesTo: attacks made with one or more [PRECISION] weapons

effect.select: one allocation group containing one of those visible CHARACTER models

afterSelectedGroupDestroyed.remainingAttacks: allocated in the normal allocation order
afterSelectedGroupDestroyed.startFrom: first group that still has models

chooserRule.meaning: controlling player of the unit selected to shoot or fight, until those attacks are resolved
